user.description: Enter your xAI API key from the xAI console. The same key powers Conversation, TTS, and STT (Voice API access is checked automatically).

data_description.chat_model: Model used for ai_task.generate_data. Options come from GET /v1/models.
data_description.recommended: When enabled, uses default max tokens and temperature.

error.model_not_supported: This model is not supported, please select a different model

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot configure while the integration is not loaded

data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response
data.auto_model_routing: Auto-route simple requests to fast model

data_description.vision_model: Fallback for image services when the chat model cannot take images. Prefer chat model when it supports images. Default grok-4.3.
data_description.fast_model: Used when auto-routing detects a short/simple command. Default grok-4.3 (no separate fast model after the May 15 2026 retirement).
data_description.fallback_model: Tried automatically if the primary model errors. Default grok-4.3.

error.model_not_supported: This model is not supported, please select a different model
error.model_retired: This model has been retired by xAI. Choose a current model such as grok-4.3.
error.llm_api_not_found: The selected LLM HASS API is not available.

ask.name: Ask (stateless)

generate_image.description: Turn a prompt into an image

config_entry.name: Config entry
